title: OKE Cluster Config
description: Schema for OKE (Oracle Container Engine for Kubernetes) cluster deployment configuration

compartmentId.description: Compartment OCID for cluster resources (defaults to tenancy/root)

isPublicIpEnabled.description: Assign a public IP to the API server endpoint

allowedCidrs.description: CIDRs allowed to reach the API server (terraform executor IP is auto-added)

manage.description: Create a tenancy-level dynamic group and policy for node instance principals (requires tenancy admin; not needed by managed node pools)

gpuDriver.description: Where the NVIDIA driver comes from; the module deploys no GPU runtime components beyond it. image: the node image ships the driver (OKE GPU platform images; Oracle GPU images for imageId pools) and OKE's default NvidiaGpuPlugin add-on stays in place. operator: driverless Ubuntu imageId; a GPU Operator installed outside this module (e.g. AICR) provides driver, toolkit, and device plugin, and OKE's NvidiaGpuPlugin is disabled on GPU pools

cni.description: Pod networking (create-time only). flannel: FLANNEL_OVERLAY, pods take addresses from network.oke.podsCidr. vcn-native: OCI_VCN_IP_NATIVE, pods take VCN IPs from the pod subnet; it disables IPv6 in pod namespaces, which breaks RoCE on RDMA VFs attached to pods, so GPU/RDMA clusters should use flannel

addons.description: OKE add-on configurations keyed by add-on name (e.g. NvidiaGpuPlugin); values map the add-on's configuration keys (oci ce addon-option list) to values. Installs the add-on, or adopts it when OKE pre-installed it. NvidiaGpuPlugin conflicts with gpuDriver: operator

nodePoolEviction.description: Optional eviction settings for managed node pools when nodes are deleted or scaled down. Absent: OKE defaults (60 minute grace, no force delete). Test and CI clusters set forceDelete so a PodDisruptionBudget cannot block teardown

gracePeriod.description: How long OKE tries to drain a node before deleting it, as an ISO-8601 duration in minutes (PT0M to PT60M)

forceDelete.description: Delete the node after the grace period even if the drain has not finished

podsCidr.description: Cluster pods CIDR setting (default: 10.240.0.0/12, room for ~8k nodes at OKE's /25 per node; create-time only, must not overlap the VCN, subnets, or servicesCidr). With cni flannel it is the pod address range; with vcn-native it does not set pod addresses: pods take VCN IPs from the pod subnet derived from cidr

subnets.description: Subnet definitions. Auto-computed from VCN CIDR if omitted.

enabled.description: Encrypt Kubernetes secrets in etcd with a customer-managed KMS key (creates a vault, key, and compartment policy for the OKE service)

name.description: Node pool name (required for worker pools)

shape.description: OCI compute shape (e.g. VM.Standard.E5.Flex); overrides the gpuType mapping

memoryGb.description: Memory in GB per node (Flex shapes only)

size.description: Number of nodes in the pool

gpuType.description: GPU accelerator type; selects the shape when shape is unset (a10=VM.GPU.A10.1, l40s=BM.GPU.L40S.4, h100=BM.GPU.H100.8, gb200=BM.GPU.GB200.4, gb300=BM.GPU.GB300.4) and a GPU image

taints.description: Kubernetes node taints (key[=value]:effect), registered by kubelet at join so the node never exists untainted. Pools that set taints bootstrap through templates/custom-image-init.sh

imageId.description: Node image OCID. Overrides OKE platform image selection (newest build for the cluster version and shape architecture). Required for aarch64 GPU shapes (GB200/GB300), which have no OKE platform image

availabilityDomains.description: Availability domain numbers (1-based) to place nodes in; defaults to every AD in the region. GPU capacity is usually AD-specific, so pin GPU pools

gpuMemoryFabricId.description: GPU memory fabric (NVL72 rack) to place this pool in. Makes the pool self-managed: a compute cluster, instance configuration, and GPU memory cluster of `size` hosts, joined to the cluster via oke-init. Requires imageId and a single availability domain
